output.reason: The linked PR [ev-ed6f68b198cb] describes two new defaults: status is ignored in diffs for all resources, not just CRDs, and user-defined differences are automatically added to ignored resource updates. Both change how Argo CD diffs and reconciles while it keeps working, which fits behavior-change (review). Neither the PR, its changed files [ev-3f74391dbd4d] nor the release note [ev-8ab94de966ea] says anything fails, is rejected or stops being honoured, so a mandatory-work kind would over-claim. The proposed statement is generic but accurate, and medium severity is reasonable for a change marked breaking.
